- Linux: dragging files into the window does not work under Wayland, a limit of the windowing library. Use Open instead. Under Wayland the window position is not remembered either.
- macOS: the file dialogs filter by extension only, so the GC, BK, GL and SS file name filters and "All files" are not offered.
- macOS: quitting from the Dock icon's menu, or logging out, restarting or shutting down, ends the app without asking about unsaved changes, and the window size and position are not saved. Cmd+Q, the app menu's Quit and the window's close button do ask.
- macOS: tabbing into a text box puts the caret at the end of its text instead of selecting it, so typing adds to the text rather than replacing it.
- macOS: the app is not signed by Apple, and the macOS build is tested automatically only. See the first-launch steps below.
